# Unlock O'Clock — GTA 6 Countdown

> Unofficial fan site with live countdowns to the Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) unlock in 30 time zones. GTA 6 releases on Thursday, November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S and unlocks at midnight local time, so the launch rolls around the world starting in New Zealand (11:00 UTC, Nov 18). Reports say the US PlayStation Store unlocks the whole US at midnight Eastern Time (9 PM Pacific on Nov 18).
